ravi: starting canary for v2.6.7-eager in EU-CENTRAL. Deploybot alerted about an unexpected increase in tail latency on streaming responses.
nina: any error spike?
deploybot: ALERT: streaming tail p99 increased by 45ms (+30%). Auto-rollback thresholds: p99 >=25% increase OR error rate >=0.5% sustained 3m. Current: p99 +30% (2m), errors 0.1%.
ops-oncall: That's over the p99 threshold. Auto-rollback should trigger if sustained another minute. We should decide if we want manual rollback now to avoid customer impact.
ravi: I prefer manual rollback to avoid hitting customers. Manual-rollback authority here. Execute `/deploy rollback --to 2.6.6 --region=eucentral` and notify #customer-notify.
deploybot: ACK: Rolling back per ravi. Graceful drain in progress.
(3m)
deploybot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE. Rollback took ~3m. p99 back to baseline.
ops-oncall: Good job. Filing a short incident note and assigning postmortem to ravi to investigate streaming buffer behavior.
nina: Will also open a PR to add more canary probes for streaming.
